authority_boundary: Operator-authorized Drive deletions only. This receipt records observed actions and hash equivalence; it does not establish scientific truth, runtime correctness, or implementation status.

reconciliation.rule: Do not invent or backfill missing Drive IDs. Unreconciled prior deletions remain unresolved until independently reconstructed from receipts or source logs.

verification_policy.stored_binary: raw SHA-256 equality plus no repository binding for deleted Drive ID or content hash
verification_policy.telemetry_exception: Execution-distinct telemetry is not E4-deduplicated merely because payload bytes match; execution/session identity must be preserved unless a separate provenance-preserving retention policy authorizes compaction.
verification_policy.delete_rule: Delete only verified redundant replicas after selecting a surviving canonical Drive object. REVISION, UNKNOWN, and execution-distinct SESSION_TELEMETRY are not deletable by this rule.

jul_02_telemetry_boundary.rule: Distinct hook UUIDs represent distinct execution identities. Equal size or equal payload bytes do not by themselves establish redundant-replica identity.
